summary: Ascentage Pharma filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 4, 2026 and an announcement dated November 5, 2026 regarding scientific presentations at the 68th ASH Annual Meeting (December 12-15, 2026, New Orleans). Disclosures cover olverembatinib, lisaftoclax, APG-5918, and APG-3288, including an oral presentation of first-in-human APG-5918 data in relapsed/refractory T-cell lymphoma. No transaction, capital event, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are described. The filing is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer current report on clinical data, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
